title: Vegan Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful vegan stew made with a variety of vegetables and a hint of Norwegian flair.
instructions: Heat a large stew pot over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until they are softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots, potatoes, and tomatoes. Cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the vegetable broth and lemon juice. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Season the stew with garlic and serve hot.
